data.title: First reminder: Muster Magazin subscription
data.summary: Muster Verlag GmbH sent a first reminder (1. Mahnung) for the annual subscription "Muster Magazin". The total due is €61.90 (€59.40 plus a €2.50 reminder fee), payable by 30 June 2025.
data.explanation: The publisher says your annual subscription fee for 1 June 2025 to 31 May 2026 is still unpaid. Transfer €61.90 to the account named in the letter by 30 June 2025. This includes a €2.50 reminder fee. If you already paid, you can ignore the letter. If you don't pay, further reminders or collection steps may follow, though the letter doesn't say so. If you think the claim is wrong, contact the publisher's customer service.
